title: Dole and pensions set to rise
full_text:
More than five million Aussies will get a fortnightly cash boost as social security payments are indexed from September 20.
The maximum Jobseeker Payment for a single recipient without children will climb $16.20 to $833.70 a fortnight, and for those on a pension, the maximum rate will increase by $36.80 for singles and $55.60 for couples. Fortnightly Parenting Payments will go up $20.90 to $1087.20 for singles, or by $14.80 to $763.00 for people with partners.
Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek said the increased payments would benefit those who needed it most.
The federal government has also accepted the Australian Government Actuary recommendation to lift social security deeming rates, which . are used to “work out income from financial assets” for the purpose of the social security means test. The deeming rate will be updated to 1.75 per cent for financial assets up to $66,800 for singles, and $110,600 for couples, with a 3.75 per cent rate for financial assets above the threshold.
